name: Music Metadata API
description:
## The Spotify `audio-features` replacement

Spotify deprecated their `audio-features` endpoint on **27 November 2024**.
This API fills that gap — look up any track by name (+ artist), ISRC, MusicBrainz ID or Spotify ID and get BPM, key, energy, danceability, valence and more back, with no audio upload needed. Have your own audio? `POST /analyze` measures an uploaded file directly.

---

### Authentication

Pass your API key in the `X-Api-Key` header:

```
X-Api-Key: fb_live_your_key_here
```

**This is a server-side API.** Your key is a secret credential (it counts against your
quota and, on paid plans, your bill), so keep it server-side and never embed it in
front-end code. Cross-origin browser requests are intentionally not allowed — a
preflight `OPTIONS` from a non-allowlisted origin is rejected — so a key can't be
scraped from client-side JavaScript. Call the API from your backend (`curl`, an SDK,
any server-to-server request; none use CORS), or proxy browser requests through your
own server.

---

### Spotify Migration Guide

| Spotify field | This API | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `tempo` | `bpm` | Same unit (BPM). Add `bpm_confidence` to filter weak beats. |
| `energy` | `energy` | Both [0-1]. RMS loudness based, on our own scale — re-derive thresholds. Different algorithm. |
| `key` + `mode` | `key`, `mode`, `camelot`, `open_key` | Human-readable key + numeric mode + Camelot + Open Key notation. |
| `loudness` | `loudness_db` | Both in dBFS. Direct equivalent. |
| `time_signature` | `time_signature` | Identical field. Most tracks return 4. |
| `duration_ms` | `duration_ms` | Full track length from catalogue metadata (catalog tracks only). |
| `danceability` | `danceability` | [0–1] on AcousticBrainz's scale — AcousticBrainz's classifier where a recording has it, otherwise a PANNs-based model (CC BY 4.0) trained on AcousticBrainz labels. Re-derive thresholds on our values. |
| `valence` | `valence` | [0–1]. A signal approximation — coarse. |
| `acousticness` | `acousticness` | [0–1]. AcousticBrainz classifier where available, otherwise a PANNs-based model (CC BY 4.0) trained on AcousticBrainz labels. |
| `instrumentalness` | `instrumentalness` | **Currently null** for catalogue tracks — neither our estimate nor AcousticBrainz's classifier is reliable enough; a replacement is being verified against human listening. |
| `liveness` | `liveness` | **Null for our own analyses** — our signal proxy read most studio tracks as live, so we return null rather than a wrong value. Populated only where an external source supplies it. |
| `speechiness` | `speechiness` | **Null for our own analyses** — our signal proxy was not reliable, so we return null rather than a wrong value. |

### Extra fields (not in Spotify)

| Field | Notes |
|---|---|
| `bpm_confidence` | Beat-strength score — filter low-rhythm/ambient tracks. |
| `key_confidence` | Key detection reliability [0–1]. Below 0.4 = atonal. |
| `camelot` | Camelot wheel notation for DJs (e.g. `8A`, `3B`). |
| `open_key` | Open Key notation for Serato / Mixed In Key users (e.g. `1m`, `4d`). |
| `mood` | MIREX-style mood category derived from valence + energy. Values: happy, calm, sad, tense, energetic, melancholic, neutral. |
| `mood_vector` | Dimensional mood scores [0–1] across 5 axes (`happy`, `sad`, `aggressive`, `relaxed`, `party`). Sourced from public music classifiers. |
| `representative_segment_start` | Start time (seconds) of the highest-energy 30-second window — the chorus or drop. Useful for sync licensing and preview generation. `/analyze` only. |
| `genre` | Broad genre classification (e.g. electronic, rock, pop, hip-hop). Sourced from public music databases. |
| `album_name` | Album or single title from catalog data. `/lookup` only. |
| `release_date` | ISO 8601 release date (YYYY-MM-DD) from catalog data. `/lookup` only. |
| `duration_ms` | Full track duration in milliseconds from catalog data. `/lookup` only. |
| `explicit` | Boolean explicit flag from catalog data. `/lookup` only. |
| `mbid` | MusicBrainz Recording ID (UUID). `/lookup` only — cross-references the open music encyclopedia. |
| `isrc` | International Standard Recording Code. `/lookup` only — uniquely identifies the master recording. |
| `itunes_track_id` | iTunes track ID (or `mb:` prefix for AcousticBrainz-sourced tracks; the former `fma:` / `msd:` ids no longer resolve). `/lookup` only. |

### New endpoints (not in Spotify)

| Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|
| `GET /bpm?bpm=128&tolerance=2` | Find catalog tracks by BPM — no audio upload needed. |
| `POST /bulk` | Look up up to 50 tracks in one request. |

**Old Spotify call** → `GET https://api.spotify.com/v1/audio-features/{id}` *(broken)*

**This API** → `POST https://api.freqblog.com/analyze` with the audio file

---

### Privacy

Uploaded audio is held only in memory or a short-lived temporary file while it is processed,
and that file is deleted as soon as processing finishes. No audio is ever kept.
Analysis results (not the audio) may be cached server-side by file hash for performance.

Operated from the United Kingdom. GDPR-compliant data handling.
